title: Science instrument calibration cadence
body: Optical instruments require monthly dark-frame, flat-field, and on-orbit star-field calibration. Calibration data downlinked at full resolution; degradation > 5% per month triggers diagnostic.
citation: Hubble SOP; James Webb COS calibration plan

title: Cryogenic detector temperature stability
body: Detectors at < 100 K shall maintain temperature stability ≤ 50 mK over 1 hour. Temperature excursions > 1 K trigger detector safe-mode (pause exposures, raise to standby T).

title: Bright object protection
body: Sun, Moon, and Earth limb angles to optical bore-sight shall remain > 50 deg, 20 deg, 30 deg respectively (mission-specific). Violations trigger automatic shutter close + pointing slew to safe direction.
citation: Hubble bright object protection rules; SDO solar pointing rules

title: Data downlink priority
body: Critical-only telemetry > Engineering housekeeping > Standard science > Bulk science. During DSN contention, lower-priority data deferred. Operator can override priority for mission-critical observations with ground concurrence.
